audit.whatIsWrong: whys[6] reads 'With two-plus items his true-damage Feast and giant HP flip it to Cho' while win[6] reads Darius, and spikes[3].text and the late paragraph both say the matchup inverts after first item. The chart says Darius owns first item and two-plus items. Separately, carryRating and report[14].t say Cho'Gath carry threat 5/10 but breakdown.carry says 7.5/10.
audit.why: Darius wins this 52.17% over 1727 games and chogath's table carries 47.83%, so the two sum to 100.0. The chart (Darius, Darius, Skill, Darius, Skill, Darius, Darius) is the exact inverse of chogath's disk chart including every rating, so it is mirror-locked and correct. The two claims reconcile once the late stages are framed as the side lane: Cho'Gath has no dash in his kit at all, so Apprehend always connects on him, while his scaling shows up in the grouped fights the late paragraph is really about.
audit.corrected: At two-plus items you still own the side lane: he has no dash and no escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 phase why is the generic Noxian Guillotine line and carries an un-rendered formula, 'R = d + a \times Stacks'. It never mentions that Feast lands on the same level, and it never compares the two executes.
audit.why: Feast is 80/70/60 seconds at 175 range and deals true damage; Noxian Guillotine is 120/100/80 at 460 range, also true damage, and refunds its cooldown on a killing blow. His execute is on a materially shorter cooldown than yours but needs him at 175 units, which is inside your own pull range. Neither is answered by armour, which is what champ-data/_kits/_missing/darius.json flags for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Noxian Guillotine is 120s of true damage refunded on a kill; Feast is 80s of true damage at 175 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tracks the wrong ability. Rupture is named as the matchup-defining cooldown in focus.text, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.spikes, breakdown.feeding, phases[3].why, phases[5].why, report[5].t, report[9].t, report[10].t, report[12].t, report[13].t, ahead and dosFull[2].d - and the page repeatedly tells the player to 'engage only on Rupture's cooldown'. Rupture is 6 seconds. There is no window. Meanwhile Feral Scream, the ability that actually decides the fight, appears only as the phrase 'silence-scream W' and as an untitled don't, with no cooldown and no statement of what the silence costs.
audit.why: Feral Scream (W) is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 seconds and a 300-range cone that silences. Every single thing Darius does in a fight is an ability cast: Apprehend to start it, Decimate for the damage and the heal, Crippling Strike for the slow, Noxian Guillotine to finish. A silence landed mid-combo removes all four at once, which is why 11 seconds is the number the player needs and 6 seconds is not. Rupture at 6s and 950 range is sidestepped, not waited out. Vorpal Spikes (E, 8/7/6/5/4s) makes his basic attacks slow everything in front of him, so he chips your walk-up without spending a cooldown at all. Cho'Gath has no dash anywhere in his kit, which is the structural reason the side lane stays yours.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream is 11s and a 300-range cone that silences - silenced, you have no pull, no Decimate and no execute, so bait it before you commit. Rupture is only 6s: sidestep it, do not wait it out.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Rupture and gives no number, then runs into two paragraphs of leaked source prose about Apprehend and Ghost that are not cooldown information at all.
audit.why: Every number the player needs is in the kit: Feral Scream 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, Rupture 6, Vorpal Spikes 8/7/6/5/4, Feast 80/70/60, against Apprehend at 26/23.5/21/18.5/16.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream 11s at rank 1 is the only trackable window; Rupture at 6s is not one.

audit.why: The tldr's instruction to freeze and deny his minion kills is right and worth keeping: Carnivore restores health and mana on every unit Cho'Gath kills, and the amount grows with his level, so wave denial attacks his sustain directly rather than incidentally. I kept it and named the passive so the player knows what the freeze is starving.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave, report[4].t and breakdown.trading contain large blocks of leaked source material: the headings 'Key Mechanical Cooldowns' and 'How Darius Wins Trades' appear mid-paragraph, a stray bullet pair renders as '• •', and breakdown.trading ends with 'Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 37', which is a page number.
audit.why: This is the same corruption pattern found on darius vs camille, so it is systemic to this file rather than a one-off.

notes: The '(Knockup)' suffix attached to Rupture across this matchup is not a Riot ability name, it is an annotation the generator appended, and it appears in fourteen fields. I replaced it wherever the field also needed a factual fix rather than proposing a pure find-and-replace. UNVERIFIED and left alone, matching the ruling in audits/top/chogath__darius.json: whether Rupture's knock-up interrupts Noxian Guillotine's leap. That claim originates in champ-data/_kits/_missing/chogath.json, not in Riot's text, and it is exactly the displacement-versus-dash question the kit files mark unknown. Nothing on this page asserts it in either direction. The Rupture kit entry also carries a derived 'grounding' flag; Riot's description says only 'popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them', with no grounding, so I treated the flag as a tooltip-parse misfire and never wrote it. Same for Darius's own E, flagged 'knockup' against a description that says only that he pulls enemies to him.
